answer: Each agent earns a reputation score stored in a tamper‑evident basalt ledger that timestamps every interaction, much like a glacier layers ice over time, so the longer an identity lives the higher its weight. When a new node tries to join, it must prove a zephyr‑fast proof‑of‑stake bond that is locked for a period proportional to the desired reputation, and any inactivity triggers linear decay of the stored weight.
